wholeGoalBefore.title: Client-Server-Dienste analysieren
wholeGoalBefore.description: Die lernende Person kann ein Netzwerkprotokoll wie POP3 oder SMTP untersuchen, Schwachstellen diskutieren und Sicherheitsaspekte einordnen.
wholeGoalBefore.descriptionEn: The learner can examine a network protocol like POP3 or SMTP, discuss vulnerabilities and classify security aspects.

ordinaryChange.reason: A learner can investigate a fully introduced application-protocol dialogue, identify states/answers and explain concrete weaknesses without previously mastering the entire IP-address/DNS/four-layer performance. The service/connection context can be given; the analysis and risk evaluation must still be performed independently. Intro is motivational, not technical mastery.

peerCountercheck.kind: independent read-only textual review, no ledger approval
peerCountercheck.judgment: Confirms the separately justified ace→orientation correction under a fully explained application-protocol context; the analysis/risk reasoning must remain own performance. GK must require TCP/IP explicitly; E25 retains its separate packet path. No global effects asserted by the peer.

criterion.description: K03 (A03/S03) – Den vollständigen SMTP-Ablauf einschließlich Anmeldung, Envelope, Datenphase und Ende untersuchen, den Token korrekt dekodieren sowie mindestens zwei konkrete Risiken mit geeigneten Maßnahmen und Grenzen einordnen; Annahme, Berechtigung und Zustellung unterscheiden. Ein Punkt nur bei insgesamt fachlich tragfähiger vollständiger zugeordneter Kompetenzleistung; bei fehlender oder wesentlich unvollständiger Leistung null Punkte.

cases.judgment: The full M2 dialogue gives connection, commands, server responses and AUTH-format context; A03 still requires the learner to analyze protocol phases, decode the token, identify two concrete risks and justify limited countermeasures. S03 retains the full answer. IP/DNS/four-layer explanation remains an independent A02 criterion and an actual preparation obligation (direct in GK, via packet competence in LK). No supplied analysis is counted as learner performance. The current narrower ace preparation therefore creates no content hold for either fixed complete contract.
cases.bounds: This is a fresh narrow source/preparation-context addendum to unchanged complete reviews, not a rewritten original hash, a new reference run, or a release.

goalMetadataReview.newGkCompetence: Exactly the fixed 24 ordinary competencies from the already reviewed GK draft, no packet competency and no optional/compensated subset. New DE/EN labels describe an own SkillPilot assessment; no translation is misrepresented as an official source text.
goalMetadataReview.oldE25: Only truthful LK offering metadata and the independently reviewed complete25 material are proposed. The original ID and exact coverage order remain. Old explicit outcomes are retained as historical results; they are not regraded under the new rubric or copied to the new GK ID.
